title.zh-CN: 反复上腹痛伴两次血钙升高
title.en: Recurrent upper abdominal pain with elevated calcium on two occasions

summary.zh-CN: 腹痛缓解后再次发作，两次都出现血钙升高及肾结石线索，需要从病因层面重新评估。
summary.en: Abdominal pain recurs after initial recovery, with elevated calcium and renal stones on both occasions.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: Fifth International Workshop 2022, checked 2026-10-28; scope repeated calcium/PTH biochemical classification and distinction from localisation.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.en: Discuss renal, bone and perioperative risks.

finding.zh-CN: 左上腹及脐周压痛，局部轻紧张，反跳可疑，Murphy阴性；颈部无可触及包块。
finding.en: Left upper/periumbilical tenderness with mild guarding and equivocal rebound, negative Murphy sign; no palpable neck mass.

text.zh-CN: 首次淀粉酶1139 U/L、钙2.76 mmol/L，CT胰腺炎及左肾结石；再次淀粉酶1055.9 U/L、钙2.87 mmol/L，CT仍见胰腺炎和结石。
text.en: Initial amylase 1139 U/L and calcium 2.76 mmol/L with CT pancreatitis and left renal stone; recurrence showed amylase 1055.9 U/L and calcium 2.87 mmol/L with pancreatitis/stones again.

text.zh-CN: 超声CT提示左甲状腺下极后方病灶，切除约2×1.5×1 cm，病理为甲状旁腺腺瘤。术前“31 pmol/L”项目原文误标可能，未直接转写为已核实PTH；术后明确标注PTH降至3.8 pmol/L、钙2.18 mmol/L。
text.en: Ultrasound/CT localised a lesion behind the lower left thyroid; a roughly 2×1.5×1 cm resection was a parathyroid adenoma. A preoperative “31 pmol/L” analyte is questionably labelled in the source and is not silently treated as verified PTH; explicitly labelled postoperative PTH fell to 3.8 pmol/L and calcium to 2.18 mmol/L.

text.zh-CN: 切除后PTH和钙维持正常，曾短暂四肢麻木而无抽搐，后自行缓解；报告随访未诉不适，时长未说明。
text.en: PTH and calcium remained normal after resection; transient limb tingling without convulsions resolved. Follow-up reported no symptoms without a specified duration.

prompt.zh-CN: 反复胰腺炎的高钙和结石意味着什么？
prompt.en: What do hypercalcaemia and stones imply in recurrent pancreatitis?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 应调查持续高钙的内分泌病因，同时保留其他胰腺炎鉴别
text.en: Investigate an endocrine cause of persistent hypercalcaemia while retaining other pancreatitis causes

feedback.zh-CN: 两次异常和结石使血钙不能被当作偶然。
feedback.en: Repeated abnormalities and stones make calcium difficult to dismiss as incidental.

text.zh-CN: 腹痛缓解后不必再查高钙
text.en: Calcium need not be reviewed once pain resolves

feedback.zh-CN: 病因未处理可能仍持续。

text.zh-CN: 摸不到颈部肿块就排除甲状旁腺病
text.en: No palpable neck lump excludes parathyroid disease

feedback.zh-CN: 小腺体病变通常不能靠触诊排除。
feedback.en: Small-gland disease cannot be excluded by palpation.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 病理与术后钙/PTH变化支持腺瘤，但术前项目标注和完整生化标准需核实
text.en: Pathology and postoperative calcium/PTH changes support an adenoma, while preoperative labelling and complete biochemical criteria need verification

feedback.zh-CN: 影像用于定位，不能取代准确生化定性。
feedback.en: Imaging localises and does not replace accurate biochemical classification.

text.zh-CN: 可把“甲状腺素31”静默改为PTH31
text.en: Silently relabel “thyroxine 31” as PTH 31

feedback.zh-CN: 这会掩盖源文项目名冲突。
feedback.en: This conceals the conflicting analyte label.

text.zh-CN: 单例证明所有胰腺炎均由腺瘤引起
text.en: This case proves all pancreatitis is caused by adenomas

feedback.zh-CN: 单例关联不能推广为普遍因果。
feedback.en: A single association is not universal causation.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前复核与管理应怎样做？
prompt.en: How should current reassessment and management proceed?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 核实重复钙、白蛋白或离子钙及PTH，评估肾骨受累并由内分泌外科讨论
text.en: Verify repeat calcium, albumin or ionised calcium and PTH, assess renal/bone effects and discuss with endocrine surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 2022国际工作组将生化诊断与定位区分，围术期也需监测低钙症状。
feedback.en: The 2022 workshop separates biochemical diagnosis from localisation; perioperative hypocalcaemic symptoms need monitoring.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭定位CT直接诊断所有功能异常
text.en: Use localisation CT alone to diagnose every functional abnormality

feedback.zh-CN: 定位不能替代激素和血钙核验。
feedback.en: Localisation does not replace hormone and calcium verification.

text.zh-CN: 把旧文禁食和抗菌方案当所有胰腺炎默认
text.en: Make historical fasting and antibiotics the default for every pancreatitis

feedback.zh-CN: 历史综合处置不构成通用当前方案。
feedback.en: Historical combined care is not a universal current regimen.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明重复高钙与结石具有病因提示。；承认完整术前PTH原始报告、白蛋白/离子钙及长期结局缺失。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Repeated hypercalcaemia and stones are aetiological clues.; acknowledge Original preoperative PTH, albumin/ionised calcium and long-term outcomes are absent. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告以反复胰腺炎为线索发现甲状旁腺腺瘤及高钙，术前一项激素名称存在不确定性。
conclusion.en: Recurrent pancreatitis led to discovery of a parathyroid adenoma with hypercalcaemia, with uncertainty in one preoperative hormone label.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 重复高钙与结石具有病因提示。
keyReasoning.en: Repeated hypercalcaemia and stones are aetiological clues.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 生化项目名错误不能被隐去。
keyReasoning.en: An analyte-labelling error must not be hidden.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 颈部触诊阴性不能排除。
teachingPoints.en: A negative neck examination does not exclude disease.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 定位和定性是不同问题。
teachingPoints.en: Localisation and classification are different questions.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 术后麻木需要低钙风险思考。

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整术前PTH原始报告、白蛋白/离子钙及长期结局缺失。
unknowns.en: Original preoperative PTH, albumin/ionised calcium and long-term outcomes are absent.
